# My Agent

Create the requested new feature and tests for it. Don't change anything else. 
Think carefully about how it should be implemented in an elegant, direct, and straight forward way.
Use the same code style and design as the current codebase.
Avoid bloated code, let the code fail loudly if it is used incorrectly or with arguments that it is not intended to recieve.
